title: Unicorn
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='horn' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffd93b'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffa63b'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='hair' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff6ec7'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#c56bff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#5bc8ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='66' rx='24' ry='15' fill='#f4f0ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='20' ry='10' fill='#dcd2f5'/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='74' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#f4f0ff'/>
  <rect x='42' y='76' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e0d8f7'/>
  <rect x='58' y='76' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#f4f0ff'/>
  <rect x='68' y='74' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#e0d8f7'/>
  <rect x='29' y='89' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b49be0'/>
  <rect x='41' y='89' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b49be0'/>
  <rect x='57' y='89' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b49be0'/>
  <rect x='67' y='89' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b49be0'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 62 Q84 58 86 68 Q88 76 78 76 Q72 74 74 68 Q82 70 82 66 Q82 62 74 64 Z' fill='url(#hair)'/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M30 62 Q26 50 32 42 L42 44 Q38 52 40 62 Z' fill='#f4f0ff'/>

  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M33 42 Q24 38 28 30 Q34 34 38 40 Z' fill='url(#hair)'/>
  <path d='M30 50 Q20 48 24 40 Q30 44 33 48 Z' fill='#ff6ec7'/>
  <path d='M28 58 Q18 58 20 50 Q27 52 30 56 Z' fill='#c56bff'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='32' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#f4f0ff'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='36' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#e6ddf8'/>
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='32' rx='2' ry='1.6' fill='#b49be0'/>

  <!-- ear -->
  <path d='M46 20 Q50 12 54 18 Q52 24 47 25 Z' fill='#f4f0ff'/>
  <path d='M48 21 Q50 16 52 20 Q51 23 48 23 Z' fill='#ffb3dd'/>

  <!-- horn -->
  <path d='M36 20 L40 4 L44 20 Z' fill='url(#horn)'/>
  <path d='M38 15 L40 8 L42 15 Z' fill='#fff3b8'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='30' rx='3' ry='3.6' fill='#3d2a6b'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='28.6' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='26' rx='3' ry='1.5' fill='#ffb3dd' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M25 38 Q28 42 33 41' stroke='#b49be0' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
